events.description: CIA email to Michael Scheuer reporting that planning for the UBL rendition is going very well, a detailed and realistic plan with 50-50 odds of getting a green light and 40-percent odds of success (UBL in custody or dead).

An email to Michael Scheuer reports that planning for the UBL rendition is going very well. The plan is described as detailed and realistic, with risks addressed. The writer puts the odds of the operation getting a green light at 50-50 and the odds of success at 40-60 (as the OCR reads, '40-00'), with success defined as UBL in custody or dead.
A planning team presents a military-style plan for a special-operations raid to render UBL. The email says odds of success are 'iffy' and the operation could fail at any point.

key_claims: The CIA rendition plan for UBL was described in May 1998 as detailed, thoughtful and realistic, fitting a military model.
The author estimated roughly 50-50 odds the operation would receive a green light.
The author estimated roughly 40 percent odds of success, defined as UBL in custody or dead.
The operation was characterized as a special ops raid with hundreds of variables that could cause it to blow up at any point.
